sentence: In H1 2026 the team booked $156,142 of revenue from 240 orders.
North was the largest region at $54,809, or 41.1% of revenue.
Monthly revenue grew from $21,215 in January to $27,704 in June, a 25.0% increase.
Q2 revenue was $77.9k, a change of -0.5% on Q1.
All 3 regions grew over the period.
